purpose: Make the owner thesis, root constraints, candidate fences, bounded work rules, sim process taxonomy, and M(C) ratchet transition operational for LLM controllers.
authority_note: This file is not canon by itself. It is a machine-readable helper aligned to the foundation role registry and human explanation packet.

pipeline_semantics.OMEGA_TH: owner thesis possibility space; not enforceable by naming
pipeline_semantics.FTR: finite translation layer; converts one thesis into one bounded fixture before formal testing
pipeline_semantics.C: active accepted constraint set: RC and accepted DC rows only
pipeline_semantics.G(C): finite gate family enforcing the active constraints
pipeline_semantics.M(C): admissible constraint manifold: survivor surface after gates, not primitive ontology
pipeline_semantics.R: ratchet transition operator: preserves receipts, kills, blockers, and next admissible gates

bounded_work_contract.why: F01 applies to the method itself. Unbounded work imports the infinity the theory forbids and fails to extract finite distinctions from high-entropy possibility.

role_rules.TH: owner thesis; may motivate a fixture but never enforces itself
role_rules.RC: root constraint; currently RC-F01 and RC-N01 only
role_rules.DC: accepted derived constraint; requires root pressure and a registered gate path
role_rules.CF: candidate fence; can guide a sim but must stay outside M(C) until promoted
role_rules.PL: process law; governs method but does not inflate derived-constraint count
role_rules.EG: enforcement gate; names observables and controls but is not a receipt
role_rules.REC: receipt; finite evidence artifact with claim ceiling
role_rules.OBJ: bounded object candidate or admitted object
role_rules.REL: relation or bridge between roles/layers; high semantic-smuggling risk
role_rules.MC: machine-safe code for M(C), the manifold projection; display notation remains M(C)
role_rules.GR: graveyard row; records killed or demoted candidates without leaving them in CF/DC as live claims

tool_function_micro_sim.use_when: a tool/API surface may become load-bearing

lego_sim.use_when: one bounded mathematical object is being admitted

orchestrator_a_process.use_when: route between recon, ratchet, compiler, and sims

llm_enforcement_rules: Never promote a CF into M(C) without a receipt.
Never treat a gate as a receipt.
Never use axiom as a machine status.
Before running a broad sim, name the process type and bounded work unit.

If a claim uses continuity, factorization, scalarization, basis, measurement, probability, time, equality, identity, closure, observer, or global context, require the matching gate or mark the primitive as blocked.
M(C) is a survivor surface induced by gates; it is not a root and not a final ontology.
If a candidate is killed, write or reference GR instead of leaving it as a live CF/DC row.
machine_checks: FTR anti-smuggling sim must pass before TH-driven formal claims
candidate fence gate receipts must stay candidate until non-redundancy is audited
CF14-CF25 candidate-gate receipts must remain candidate-only until explicit CF-to-DC review
candidate_fence_nonredundancy_audit_results.json must pass before any CF14-CF25 CF-to-DC review
next_process_step: Candidate-gate layer CF14-CF25 is receipted. Next step is explicit CF-to-DC review plus M(C) recompute/archive if any candidate is promoted.
